notes: Read the complete 556-line source App.tsx line by line before editing; the native output maps every lazy route and Route/Navigate entry through the existing 157-entry native webRouteManifest sourced from web/src/App.tsx.

Preserved SafeRoute intent, route names, source paths, redirect targets, top-level standalone routes, layout-owned routes, catch-all routes, recent-page recording delay/title suffix behavior, and re-auth return-url validation with React Native-safe state instead of react-router-dom, window, or sessionStorage.

Browser-only ScrollRestoration, DensityApplier, ContextMenuRoot, DOM route announcer, and Suspense chunk loading are represented as explicit native-safe unavailable adaptations in the rendered parity panel.

The conversion imports only React Native primitives plus existing apps/native route metadata, tokens, and UI components; it does not import DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components.
